info.title: Rotor
info.description: Rotor's HTTP API: workflows across Exciter, Armature and Stator. Every endpoint answers JSON; errors share one envelope. Sign in through the suite's identity provider; the session is a cookie.

get.summary: A run's events as server-sent events, from the start or after Last-Event-ID, until the run ends.
get.description: Content type text/event-stream. Each event's id is its sequence number, its event name its type and its data the JSON {seq, type, node, payload, at}, with the payloads of docs/api-contract-m2.md. ?after= stands in for Last-Event-ID.

post.summary: Add a tool by its address; Rotor registers itself there as an OAuth client.
post.description: Reads the tool's /api/v1/meta, which must offer mcp@1, then its protected resource and authorization server metadata (RFC 9728, RFC 8414), and registers by RFC 7591 unless a client is given. Adding an address Rotor already knows registers again, for a tool that forgot its client.

post.summary: Start a run of a workflow as yourself.
post.description: An Idempotency-Key header makes a retried request answer the run it started, with 200. A binding to a tool you are not connected to is refused with 409 code connections_needed, whose fields map each tool's name to its id (empty for a tool this installation does not have).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any text of at most 200 characters, new for each run; a retry sends the same.
